prompt: With arm1, take vial1 from the bench to the scanner if the spectro sensor is working when arm1 picks the vial up; if it is not, put vial1 in the fridge.
why: The request needs a choice made at run time from the state of the world. RoboLang 1.3 has no if/else: `pre` only stops a run, and a goal states one fixed end state. RoboLang 1.4 (decision 0027) expresses it with `if`.
